title: Spicy Ground Beef Cabbage Wraps with Peanut Sauce
description: An Asian-inspired ground beef filling is wrapped in cabbage with a spicy, creamy peanut sauce in this easy recipe that's perfect as an appetizer or main dish.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons sambal oelek (chile paste), or more to taste
0.25 cup water, or more as needed
2 teaspoons sambal oelek, or more to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, sambal oelek, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, and red pepper flakes for sauce together in a small bowl. Whisk in small amount of water slowly until well combined and you reach your desired consistency. Set aside.

Heat a medium skillet over medium heat. Brown the ground beef, green onions, and garlic for about 5 minutes. Stir in rice vinegar, sambal oelek, cardamom, ginger, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.

Divide the ground beef mixture evenly among the 12 cabbage leaves. Top each with a dollop of the peanut sauce, a squeeze of a lime wedge, and sprinkle with peanuts. Fold up the sides of the leaves and serve.
